decisions.reason: My Flow, Calendar and ICS now consume the same effective date, including explicit date removal.
Home owns usage examples and continuation; Find owns search, catalog and source inspection.
decisions.reopenWhen: Observed users cannot distinguish the first task or success state.

decisions.reason: No production telemetry or review contract exists. Fake user or review counts are prohibited.
decisions.reopenWhen: A real aggregation and moderation contract exists.

decisions.reason: Wedding artifact choice and workout summary-first settings use one shared result-first skeleton without flattening content differences.
Compact library rows open one dedicated workspace with execute, whole plan and record roles.
Archive, restore and permanent delete are distinct and have mobile/wide capability parity.
Item detail uses a sheet while undated placement remains a separate mode.
Delete is available only from archived state, removes personal local data, preserves public source and supports source rediscovery.
The Home/Find role split passed the current automated and heuristic gate without changing the 4-tab IA.
decisions.reopenWhen: Observed users repeatedly fail the Home/Find distinction.

decisions.reason: P31 required consumer precedence and composition changes, not a persistence or identity rewrite.
Observed-user recruitment was explicitly outside this gate.
